intro_text: p_l didn't exactly plan to have other cats with {PRONOUN/p_l/object}, but {PRONOUN/p_l/subject} {VERB/p_l/were/was} grateful for the help anyway, especially with the amount of blooming plants. That is, until r_c started sneezing. Clearly, the pollen from the blooming flowers and grasses was affecting {PRONOUN/r_c/object} somewhat.
decline_text: Due to r_c clearly not being fully up to a patrol involving plants and pollen, the patrol returns to camp with no new herbs. At least r_c seems to have stopped sneezing for now.

success_outcomes.text: p_l doesn't acknowledge r_c sneezing, opting to continue the patrol. Despite the circumstances, greenleaf is merciful on the group, and the patrol returns with an average collection of herbs.

p_l doesn't see r_c having a running nose as a burden. In fact, to p_l, it's an opportunity. Sure, it's very unhelpful when it comes to finding the herbs, but in terms of collecting the herbs that have a less pleasant smell, it makes r_c the perfect collector. When the  patrol comes across a patch of some pungent-scented herbs, r_c is sent to collect them.

fail_outcomes.text: The patrol continues their search for herbs, despite r_c and their plight. Unfortunately, the group doesn't get very far. r_c stumbles mid sneeze, tripping over a root and tumbling forward, knocking over other cats in their wake.
